description: Take a seat in the great outdoors with Rothco’s Collapsible 4 Leg Camp Stool. This powerful portable stool features a rugged double-layered composition and folds into an included storage pouch for easy carrying. Powder-coated steel legs on the camp stool prevent rust and protect against the elements The large seating platform accommodates up to 300lbs (Backpacking stool measures 12.5 inches x 12.5 inches x 13.7 inches). A convenient side pocket is great for holding cell phones, drinks, snacks, and more in the folding stool.
